dvayatānupassanāsutta.p: [Dvayatānupassanā+sutta] (na) CL=8 Dvayatā nupassanā sutta,( sutta which is preached about if  a person who repeately meditate ona set dhamma of the two truth that are Noble Truth of Suffering and Noble Truth of Original of Suffering, a set dhamma of the two truth that are Noble Truth of Cessation of Suffering and  magga saccā, who can be attained Anāgāmiphiula or Arahattaphiula at present (life).
pn: Dvayatānupassanāsutta. A dissertation delivered by the Buddha, outside the Migārāmātupāsāda, on a full-moon day. He tells of the twofold insight – the insight of dukkha and its cause, nirodha and the way thereto. He then proceeds to explain the origin of dukkha, from upadhi, avijjā, etc. (Snp. p.139ff).
